profile.name: Alex Morgan
profile.intro: I turn unclear problems into clear interfaces and dependable digital products.

image.alt: An illustrated research notebook layered over a Pacific Northwest coastal landscape.

profile.availability: Available for select product and engineering collaborations.

about: I work across product strategy, interface design, and full-stack engineering. I enjoy turning an unclear problem into a small, durable system that people can understand and trust.
My best work happens alongside teams that value direct communication, careful craft, and steady iteration. Away from the screen, I am usually reading, cooking, or exploring the Pacific Northwest.

experience.summary: Lead product engineering for early-stage teams, from technical discovery through launch. Built shared frontend foundations and helped teams make sound product and architecture decisions.
Shipped collaboration tools used by distributed teams. Improved accessibility, performance, and release confidence across the core web application.
Designed and developed customer-facing web products for mission-driven organizations, with an emphasis on practical design systems and maintainable code.
